dict.string: Kikiwake reads recordings in your Documents folder and saves transcripts next to them. Your recordings and transcripts stay on your Mac.
Kikiwake reads recordings on your Desktop and saves transcripts next to them. Your recordings and transcripts stay on your Mac.
Kikiwake reads recordings in your Downloads folder and saves transcripts next to them. Your recordings and transcripts stay on your Mac.
Kikiwake reads recordings on external drives and saves transcripts next to them. Your recordings and transcripts stay on your Mac.
Kikiwake reads recordings on network shares and saves transcripts next to them. Your recordings and transcripts are not sent anywhere else.
Kikiwake reads recordings in cloud storage folders such as Google Drive and saves transcripts next to them. Kikiwake itself doesn't send your recordings or transcripts anywhere.
